review:
One of Pragmatic's earlier variable-ways games, on a 5x6 layout with up to 7,776 ways. Tumbles replace winning symbols, and mystery and giant symbols can cover several spots at once.

The free spins add a random feature on every spin, so the reels can behave differently from one spin to the next. The in-game screen advertises up to 19,000x – far higher than most Pragmatic games of that era – and the 96.53% RTP is strong.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
